about: Moving heads and servos: a beam from each head's cell where its pan and tilt point it, in its color, a filled cone widening and softening, its light reaching four times as far as it is set to be drawn and fading gently to its end, with a flare at the lens, under every dot; a 16-bit head leaning right, an 8-bit head hung upside down, one pointing at the viewer (its far end a soft disc round the head), one turned to face the left, a dark one with no beam or flare; and two servos' arms, at Home and turned 90°.
